source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: In the opponent’s [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), Mortarion may use Inflamed Reprisal while he has it. The trigger is an attack targeting one of your **DEATH GUARD** units no farther than 6″ from him. After the enemy resolves its attacks, the friendly target may fire back as in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase). It can target only the attacker, if eligible, and worsens its Ballistic Skill by 1 for those attacks.

trigger.event: attack targets friendly DEATH GUARD unit
